commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' Toti (Wolves) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+2' Ivo Grbic blocks Joao Gomes (Wolves)'s effort from the edge of the box.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Pablo Sarabia is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Matt Doherty (Wolves).
85' That will be all from Hee-Chan Hwang who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
83' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
82' Oliver Norwood goes off the pitch and Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd) comes on.
82' Chris Wilder has decided to make a change. Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) replaces Vini Souza.
82' It's time for a substitution. William Osula (Sheffield Utd) comes on in place of Rhian Brewster.
82' Sheffield Utd have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
81' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Sheffield Utd get a corner.
80' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
77' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Rayan Ait-Nouri is replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
73' Joao Gomes (Wolves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Sheffield Utd.
72' Substitution. Yasser Larouci will be replaced by Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd).
72' The referee shows a yellow card to Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
72' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nelson Semedo (Wolves) was quite harsh and Darren Bond didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
70' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Pedro Neto (Wolves).
69' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

66' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
64' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
60' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 66:34.
57' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) serves up a nice cross, but Ivo Grbic punches the ball away.
56' That looked a certain handball by Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!

54' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
53' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
50' The Sheffield Utd players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Neat passing move from Wolves in order to create new attacking opportunities.
42' A cross into the box from Pedro Neto (Wolves) is cleared.
38' Wolves enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
36' Pedro Neto (Wolves) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
35' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
33' The referee awards a corner and Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) goes over to take it.
31' 1 - 0 Goal! Rayan Ait-Nouri picks out Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the right side of the goal with a header from close range. 1:0.

29' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Jose Sa anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
27' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
24' Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
20' Pedro Neto (Wolves) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
19' Sheffield Utd have been awarded a corner kick.

19' Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Jose Sa has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Sheffield Utd are awarded a corner kick.
17' Pedro Neto (Wolves) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
17' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolves.
14' Max Kilman (Wolves) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
13' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

13' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
12' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) brings an opponent down and Darren Bond interrupts the game. Wolves have a free kick.
10' Wolves control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
8' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but Ivo Grbic comes off his line to gather the ball.

5' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
2' The Wolves players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Wolves will take the kick-off.
Darren Bond got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
